about: The blog's rubber-stamp pictures, one per article, shot in Minato by tools/minato-stamp-shoot.mjs. Ship frames: x across (+ port), y above the keel (engine-room floor plates at 0.9 m, bridge deck 10 m), z from the stern.

shots.name: blog-harbour
shots.note: The blog's header: the harbour with the Minato Maru alongside at dusk
shots.alt: Minato's harbour at dusk, printed as a rubber stamp from Johansson World.

shots.name: blog-harbour-ferry
shots.note: The blog header option: the Minato Maru alongside the quay at dusk, from across the harbour (not used: the camera stood over a roof)
shots.alt: The Minato Maru alongside the quay at dusk, printed as a rubber stamp from Johansson World.

shots.name: torn-poster
shots.note: Sakura Shōten's front, where Thuận's sale poster hangs
shots.alt: Sakura Shōten on Minato's main street, printed as a rubber stamp.
shots.caption: Sakura Shōten, where Thuận's sale poster hangs, in Johansson World.

shots.name: navigation-light

shots.alt: The ferry Minato Maru at dusk, printed as a rubber stamp.
shots.caption: The Minato Maru at dusk, her navigation lights on, in Johansson World.
shots.alt_sv: Färjan Minato Maru i skymningen, tryckt som en gummistämpel.
shots.caption_sv: Minato Maru i skymningen med lanternorna tända, i Johansson World.

shots.name: three-phase
shots.note: The main switchboard's generator and synchronising panels: 440 V, 60 Hz

shots.alt_sv: Generatorpanelerna på ett fartygs huvudtavla, med sina instrument, tryckta som en gummistämpel.
shots.caption_sv: Huvudtavlan på Minato Maru: generatorpanelerna, 440 V och 60 Hz.

shots.name: switchboard
shots.note: The engine control booth: the main switchboard and the engine console
shots.alt: A ship's engine control room with the main switchboard and the engine console, printed as a rubber stamp.
shots.caption: The engine control room on the Minato Maru: the main switchboard and the engine console.
shots.alt_sv: Kontrollrummet på ett fartyg med huvudtavlan och maskinpulpeten, tryckt som en gummistämpel.
shots.caption_sv: Kontrollrummet på Minato Maru: huvudtavlan och maskinpulpeten.

shots.name: insulation-alarm

shots.caption: The main switchboard on the Minato Maru, with the three earth lamps of its insulated (IT) system.
shots.alt_sv: Synkroniserings- och utgångspanelerna på en huvudtavla, med de tre jordfelslamporna, tryckta som en gummistämpel.
shots.caption_sv: Huvudtavlan på Minato Maru med de tre jordfelslamporna för det isolerade IT-systemet.

shots.caption: The fire pumps in the Minato Maru's engine room.
shots.alt_sv: Brandpumparna i ett fartygs maskinrum, tryckta som en gummistämpel.
shots.caption_sv: Brandpumparna i maskinrummet på Minato Maru.
